source_notes: D25 2021-25 historical ASOF selection; explicitly excludes L/Q/R/U 585 tickers; NOT calendar disjoint OOS, prospective OOS, official PIT or certified execution.

policies.E0: next day market open full 100% S0 or S1 (where available)
policies.E1: previous close near [support,support+3%] then NEXT OPEN >=support and <=support*1.05; actual open price only
policies.E2: E1 50% then 2nd 50% after later rising close above support; NEXT OPEN >=support <=support*1.08
policies.E3: close near support then later rising close confirm; NEXT OPEN >=support <=support*1.08; actual open only

fill_model: At the NEXT OPEN only: if close previous day authorizes and open<support, reject new E1/E2/E3 buy; if open>cap reject; otherwise execute at ACTUAL OPEN. No intraday low-based fills. E0 original immediate full entry unchanged. Real-world execution unverified.
exit: close below locked support at day t -> next trading day OPEN; D30 last bar below support marked late_stop not executed
report: Per-signal including cash and traded-only, n executed, n gap/cap rejects, stop tails, capital-days, no re-entry, base and stress10bp/side.
evaluation_scope: U replay diagnostic with originally seen sample, PLUS new disjoint V200 historical research
